name: Residence Permit Based on Work

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a specific job with a specific employer; the permit is employer-specific and work cannot begin before the permit is granted.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from an Icelandic employer.

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum secure means of support of ISK 259,951 per month, demonstrated for the entire duration of the requested permit.

Under the labour-shortage category, the employer must show no suitable candidate exists in Iceland, the EEA/EFTA area, or the Faroe Islands. Under the expert-knowledge category, the applicant's expertise (university-level or technical training) must be shown essential to the employer.

evidence_required.document: Health insurance (min. ISK 2,000,000 coverage, valid 3+ months)

outcome.duration_length: 1 year initial permit, renewable to 2 years if no wage/tax issues; standard processing up to 180 days, expedited 30 days for qualified professionals

sources.title: Island.is -- Residence Permit Based on Work: Requirements: employer-specific permit, ISK 259,951/month income floor, labour-shortage vs expert-knowledge test categories, health insurance

Work in Iceland (Directorate of Labour / government-run relocation portal) -- Residence Permit: 1yr initial, 2yr renewal, permanent residence eligible after 4 continuous years, 180-day standard / 30-day expedited processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Iceland). work_rights and study_rights modeled 'restricted' since the permit is tied to the specific sponsoring employer and position, standard for employer-sponsored permits in this dataset. No self-employment/business-owner residence category was confirmed at tier-1 precision in this pass -- Iceland does not appear to run a formal investor/golden-visa residence program comparable to Bulgaria or Luxembourg; not modeled as a separate route, flagged as a gap should one emerge.
